_source: Interface copy: every label, button and caption the chrome and the shared sections print. {tokens} are filled from info.json, contact.json and fees.json at build time, so a figure changed there changes here too.

footer.blurb: Connecting {city} with trusted local shops and fairly paid riders — inside {radius} km, within {hours} hours.
footer.madeFor: Made with care for local communities
footer.ctaText: Shops you already trust, riders paid fairly, and every fee written down.

notFound.title: This street isn't on our map.
notFound.body: The page you asked for does not exist — perhaps it moved, perhaps it was never here. Everything else is a tap away.

error.title: That did not load.
error.body: A part of this page failed to render. Try again — and if it keeps happening, write to us.

search.label: Search QuickLocal
search.emptyText: Try a shorter word — or ask a person.
search.error: Search could not load. Check your connection and try again.

share.label: Share
share.failed: Could not copy — the link is in the address bar

install.title: Put QuickLocal on your home screen
install.text: This site installs like an app — its own icon, full screen, and the pages you opened still there without a signal.
install.iosSteps: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install.note: The store apps for ordering, selling and delivering are on their way; this is the website, installed.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.text: This page has not been opened on this device yet, so there is no copy of it to show. Pages you have visited before still open without a signal.
